note: REAL living room, Floor 1 LOWER-RIGHT, PRJ-2026-002 (anonymized). Derived 2026-07-04 to REPLACE the FICTIONAL living_condo.json (which is retired). METHOD (same discipline as master_bedroom/sitting_room — honesty load-bearing): this is an OPEN-PLAN living zone (open north to the dining/kitchen) with no dedicated room dimension on the sheet, so WIDTH ~4800 x DEPTH ~4200 mm are ESTIMATED from the drafter's F03.100x100 coffee table (1000x1000, an authoritative built-in code used as the raster scale) — pending a cleaner CAD export. ARRANGEMENT is from the plan (page0 floor-1 crop): a 3-seat sofa facing the TV, a 1000x1000 coffee table (F03), a 2000x400 console (F02.200x40x50), 2 armchairs, 2 round lamp side tables, TV wall-mounted on the foyer/stair partition. This is the ROOM TYPE the designer round-2 critiqued (TV on the floor / TV behind the seated viewer) so the fixes are enforced here: TV is WALL-MOUNTED (mount_mm 900, floats — not a floor block) and FACES the sofa; the sofa faces the TV; the armchairs flank the group clear of the sofa->TV corridor (seating_clear_of_screen). ORIENTATION note: the plan puts the TV on the WEST wall (sofa faces east); modelled on the NORTH wall (sofa faces south) to keep the materializer's axis-aligned rotation convention (rot 90/270 swaps w/d about the centre) — the TV<->sofa relationship, the point of the critique, is preserved. Exact furniture XY is ergonomic DESIGN JUDGEMENT within the estimated envelope, gate-verified, not traced. Coord frame: mm, origin SW, x east, y north, front = -Y at rot 0.
